articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary: Microsoft drops 167 vulns like confetti, including a SharePoint zero-day and something deliciously named 'BlueHammer' in Windows Defender. April showers bring security flowers, apparently.

articles.title: Germany Doxes “UNKN,” Head of RU Ransomware Gangs REvil, GandCrab
articles.summary: Russian GRU hackers turn grandma's router into Microsoft Office token harvesting machines. Because why break in when you can just wait for everyone to log in through your digital honeypot?

articles.title: OpenAI locks GPT-5.5-Cyber behind velvet rope despite slamming Anthropic for doing exactly that
articles.summary: Critical cPanel vuln gets weaponized faster than you can say 'shared hosting nightmare.' CISA confirms active exploitation while victims wake up to ransomware love letters.

articles.title: Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Security for AI Vulnerability Scanning
articles.summary: CopyFail Linux kernel vuln hands out root privileges like Halloween candy to any local user. Most kernels and distros affected because sharing is caring, even when it shouldn't be.

articles.title: A Bridge to Somewhere: How to Link Your Mastodon, Bluesky, or Other Federated Accounts
articles.summary: German authorities finally unmask 'UNKN,' the 31-year-old Russian mastermind behind REvil and GandCrab ransomware empires. Daniil Shchukin's resume: 130+ acts of digital sabotage and counting.

articles.title: Digital Hopes, Real Power: From Connection to Collective Action
articles.summary: ALPR surveillance networks exposed through public records requests, so naturally states want to pull the transparency curtains shut. Can't have citizens knowing about their own surveillance, apparently.

articles.title: Open Records Laws Reveal ALPRs’ Sprawling Surveillance. Now States Want to Block What the Public Sees.
articles.summary: Utah declares war on VPNs next week because nothing says 'freedom' like blocking the tools that preserve it. Predictable VPN usage surge incoming as residents scramble for digital anonymity.

articles.title: First reports come in of victims of critical cPanel vuln as 'millions' of sites potentially exposed
articles.summary: AI discovers decades of buried code sins faster than developers can patch them, creating a 'patch tsunami.' Britain's cyber agency warns the technical debt collectors are finally calling.

articles.title: 30,000 Facebook Accounts Hacked via Google AppSheet Phishing Campaign
articles.summary: Trellix gets pwned with unauthorized source code repository access because even cybersecurity companies aren't immune to irony. Forensic experts called in to explain how the watchers got watched.

articles.title: Polymarket Rejects Data Breach Claims as Hacker Alleges 300K Records Stolen
articles.summary: French 15-year-old allegedly hacks national ID agency and tries selling millions of citizen records on the dark web. Kids these days skip lemonade stands and go straight to data brokering.
